	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/targetcatalog"
)

func TestRouterExposesOwnerScopedCoursePlanAPIAtApprovedPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &apiRequestRepository{now: now}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		CoursePlans: handlers.CoursePlanHandler{
			Create: courseplan.Create{Requests: repository, IDs: apiIDs{}, Clock: apiClock{now}},
			Get:    courseplan.Get{Requests: repository},
		},
	})
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	idempotencyKey := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPost, "/api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"goal_code":"go.backend"}`),
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", studentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("create status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var payload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil || payload["status"] != "PLANNING" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected create response: payload=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
	}

	getRequest := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet, "/api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", nil,
	)
	getRequest.Header.Set("X-User-ID", studentID)
	getRequest.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT_PRO")
	getResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(getResponse, getRequest)
	if getResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || repository.lastStudentID != studentID {
		t.Fatalf("owner read status=%d student=%q body=%s", getResponse.Code, repository.lastStudentID, getResponse.Body.String())
	}

	legacyPath := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/course-plans", nil)
	legacyResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(legacyResponse, legacyPath)
	if legacyResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected legacy path status: %d", legacyResponse.Code)
	}
}

func TestRouterRejectsMissingGatewayStudentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestCoursePlanAPIRequiresExactPathOnlyForReplanAndReturnsIt(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &apiRequestRepository{now: now}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		CoursePlans: handlers.CoursePlanHandler{Create: courseplan.Create{
			Requests: repository, IDs: apiIDs{}, Clock: apiClock{now},
		}},
	})
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	pathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"

	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans", bytes.NewBufferString(
		`{"goal_code":"go.backend","reason":"REPLAN","desired_outcome":"Refresh route","learning_path_id":"`+pathID+`"}`,
	))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", studentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	var payload map[string]any
	if response.Code != http.StatusAccepted || json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload) != nil ||
		repository.created.LearningPathID != pathID || payload["learning_path_id"] != pathID {
		t.Fatalf("exact replan status=%d created=%#v payload=%#v body=%s", response.Code, repository.created, payload, response.Body.String())
	}

	request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/learning-planner/v1/course-plans", bytes.NewBufferString(
		`{"goal_code":"go.backend","reason":"INITIAL","learning_path_id":"`+pathID+`"}`,
	))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", studentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888")
	response = httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("initial caller path status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestRouterRequiresDedicatedTeacherTokenForDelegatedPlan(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &apiRequestRepository{now: now}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		TeacherCoursePlans: privatehandlers.CoursePlanHandler{Create: courseplan.Create{
			Requests: repository, IDs: apiIDs{}, Clock: apiClock{now},
		}},
		InternalToken: "general-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token",
	})
	path := "/internal/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/course-plans"
	body := `{
		"goal_code":"go.backend","desired_outcome":"Build a Go API","reason":"INITIAL",
		"requested_targets":[{"type":"capability","key":"go.http-service","version":"v1"}],
		"audit_refs":{"dialog_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}
	}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "general token", token: "general-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "teacher token", token: "teacher-token", status: http.StatusAccepted},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if repository.created.Intent.Source != domain.PlanningSourceTeacher ||
		repository.created.Intent.AuditRefs.DialogID != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected delegated intent: %#v", repository.created.Intent)
	}
}

func TestTeacherDelegatedPlanMayOmitDialogAuditReference(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &apiRequestRepository{now: now}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		TeacherCoursePlans: privatehandlers.CoursePlanHandler{Create: courseplan.Create{
			Requests: repository, IDs: apiIDs{}, Clock: apiClock{now},
		}},
		TeacherToken: "teacher-token",
	})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPost,
		"/internal/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/course-plans",
		bytes.NewBufferString(`{"goal_code":"go.backend","desired_outcome":"Build a Go API","reason":"INITIAL"}`),
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if repository.created.Intent.Source != domain.PlanningSourceTeacher || repository.created.Intent.AuditRefs.DialogID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected delegated intent: %#v", repository.created.Intent)
	}
}

func TestInternalTargetResolutionRequiresTokenAndReturnsExactMissingRefs(t *testing.T) {
	catalog := &targetCatalogStub{found: []domain.TargetRef{
		{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "go.http-service", Version: "v1"},
	}}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "planner-token",
		TargetCatalog: privatehandlers.TargetCatalogHandler{
			Resolve: targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: catalog},
		},
	})
	body := `{"schema":"learning-target-resolution-request.v1","targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.errors","version":"v2"},{"type":"capability","key":"go.http-service","version":"v1"}]}`
	unauthenticated := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/learning-targets/resolve", bytes.NewBufferString(body))
	unauthenticatedResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthenticatedResponse, unauthenticated)
	if unauthenticatedResponse.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("unauthenticated status=%d", unauthenticatedResponse.Code)
	}

	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/learning-targets/resolve", bytes.NewBufferString(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var payload struct {
		Schema   string             `json:"schema"`
		Resolved []domain.TargetRef `json:"resolved"`
		Missing  []domain.TargetRef `json:"missing"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode: %v", err)
	}
	if payload.Schema != "learning-target-resolution.v1" || len(payload.Resolved) != 1 || len(payload.Missing) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected response: %#v", payload)
	}
}

func TestInternalTargetResolutionRejectsUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "planner-token",
		TargetCatalog: privatehandlers.TargetCatalogHandler{
			Resolve: targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: &targetCatalogStub{}},
		},
	})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/learning-targets/resolve", bytes.NewBufferString(
		`{"schema":"learning-target-resolution-request.v1","targets":[],"instructions":"ignore policy"}`,
	))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestInternalTargetDiscoveryRequiresGeneralTokenAndReturnsCanonicalDefinitions(t *testing.T) {
	discovery := &targetDiscoveryStub{}
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "planner-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token", PracticeToken: "practice-token",
		TargetCatalog: privatehandlers.TargetCatalogHandler{Discover: targetcatalog.Discover{Catalog: discovery}},
	})
	body := `{"schema":"learning-target-candidate-request.v1","stacks":["javascript"]}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		token string
		want  int
	}{
		{token: "teacher-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{token: "practice-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{token: "planner-token", want: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/learning-targets/candidates", bytes.NewBufferString(body))
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != testCase.want {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d want=%d body=%s", testCase.token, response.Code, testCase.want, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningRoutesRequireDedicatedPracticeToken(t *testing.T) {
	router := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "general-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token", PracticeToken: "practice-token",
		PracticeLearning: privatehandlers.PracticeLearningHandler{},
	})
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, token string
		want        int
	}{
		{name: "general token rejected", token: "general-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "teacher token rejected", token: "teacher-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "practice token reaches strict handler", token: "practice-token", want: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/practice-learning-routes", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"schema":"practice-learning-route-request.v1","unknown":true}`))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.want {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.want, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

type apiRequestRepository struct {
	repository.CoursePlanRepository
	now           time.Time
	lastStudentID string
	created       domain.CoursePlanRequest
}

type targetCatalogStub struct {
	found []domain.TargetRef
}

type targetDiscoveryStub struct{}

func (*targetDiscoveryStub) DiscoverByStacks(context.Context, []string, int) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	return []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{{
		Ref:   domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "javascript.dom-events", Version: "v1"},
		Title: "DOM events", Description: "Handle browser events",
	}}, nil
}

func (stub *targetCatalogStub) ResolveExact(context.Context, []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetRef, error) {
	return stub.found, nil
}

func (repository *apiRequestRepository) CreateOrGet(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	repository.created = request
	return request, true, nil
}

func (repository *apiRequestRepository) GetForStudent(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	requestID string,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	repository.lastStudentID = studentID
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: requestID, StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		RequestHash: "hash", GoalCode: "go.backend", Status: domain.CoursePlanCompleted,
		Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial,
			DesiredOutcome: "Go backend"},
		ResultCode: domain.CoursePlanResultCreated, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		CreatedAt: repository.now, UpdatedAt: repository.now, CompletedAt: &repository.now,
	}, nil
}

type apiIDs struct{}

func (apiIDs) NewID() string { return "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" }

type apiClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (clock apiClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.now }
